summary: Canonical proposal-only V8 systems source resolving V7C01-V7C09. It defines 126 unique prospective test-by-phase rows, equality-bound phase manifests, closed registry generation, atomic candidate closure and promotion, a finite sealed per-invocation sub-DAG, typed GPU/reporter/claim evidence edges, G0 echo closure, a real release chain, and whole-system visibility.

authority_boundary.future_rule: Every action requires separately exact action-bound human authority plus every typed prerequisite; agreement or this proposal never implies authority.
authority_boundary.evidence_state: All rows, manifests, receipts, audits, reviews, results, reports, verdicts, claims, and releases defined here are prospective and UNPRODUCED_UNEVALUATED.

organism_boundary.THINK: Continuing waking thought, action, public outcome, judgment, and prospective intention.
organism_boundary.DREAM: Disposable finite waking-context management only; no evidence or candidate conditioning.
organism_boundary.SLEEP: Noncreative compilation of independently eligible grounded child-authored experience followed by a fresh-from-immutable-birth personal LoRA write.
organism_boundary.restatement_rule: Parent-influenced meaning enters later SLEEP only through a new complete child-authored commit with independent same-life public grounding; parent assertion, exact-string repetition, DREAM retention, or outcome valence alone never qualifies.
organism_boundary.repetition_rule: Repetition is waking practice of meaning across varied situations, not exact-string copying and never direct SLEEP evidence.

canonical_registry_source.rule: This object is the sole hand-authored systems source. Registry, source-product, schema, capability, bridge, action, receipt, phase, invocation-DAG, and visibility manifests are deterministically regenerated and equality-bound to its root; generated views may not be hand-patched.

lifetime_classes.rule: Sealed append persists for frozen retention; producer handle closes after one append.
Exists only for producing invocation and one declared close/reissue boundary.
Content-addressed bytes persist for project lineage; handles are per invocation.
Content-addressed bytes are immutable, non-overwritable, and root-bound on reissue.
Only sealed current version is active and every advance is atomic.
Detailed finding has no semantic, science, authority, or release bridge.
Authenticated external bytes expire at deadline or first successful use; replay denied.

canonical_registry_source.schema_generation_rule: Generate exactly each artifact payload_schema_id plus each operation request/result schema. Missing, duplicate, unknown, or stale schema IDs fail closed.
canonical_registry_source.source_product_equality_rule: For each source the materialized sorted products must exactly equal artifact definitions naming that sole producer.

generated_artifact_instance_rules.artifact_class: the exact output artifact class or ACCEPTANCE_TEST_PHASE_MANIFEST for phase manifest identities

capability_generation.rule: For each sealed action-instance input/output edge generate exactly one capability binding producer, sole consumer, operation, artifact class/root, namespace, action_instance_id, retry identity, epoch, expiry, nonce, request schema, and result schema.
capability_generation.handle_lifetime: ONE_CONSUMER_ONE_INVOCATION; closes on success, denial, completion, revocation, or epoch end.
capability_generation.bridge_rule: Cross-epoch edge only from a sealed predecessor result: close source handle, verify exact class/root, issue new consumer handle, append fixed transition receipt.
capability_generation.equality_rule: BIND_EQUALITY never contains or returns dereferenceable content.

closure_proofs: Every lifetime, schema, producer, principal, source, operation, action, prerequisite, result, capability, and bridge resolves exactly once.
Each artifact instance has exactly one producer; source product manifests equal the canonical producer projection.
All action prerequisites are external/frozen or produced by exactly one strictly lower-rank action.
Every result identity has one declared artifact class, lifetime, schema, producer, and consumer edge.
Unknown, missing, duplicate, extra, aliased, stale, or mismatched references fail closed.

frozen_source_products: all other frozen scientific contracts registered in artifact_definitions

acceptance_lattice.ordering_rule: STATIC_SCHEMA and G0_FAKE_RUNTIME guard A_V8_G0_INSTALL_FAIL_CLOSED_GATE; G1 guards A_V8_G2_SEAL_ACTION_INSTANCE_MANIFEST; G2 guards A_V8_G3_DISPATCH_GPU_RESOURCE; G3 guards A_V8_G3_REPORT_GPU_SCORES and A_V8_G3_RUN_EXTERNAL_SCIENCE; G4 guards A_V8_G4_MAKE_SCIENTIFIC_CLAIM and A_V8_G4_TRANSFER_OPAQUE_RELEASE. No dynamic row precedes its constructibility producer.
acceptance_lattice.failure_rule: Missing, duplicate, extra, aliased, stale, failed, wrong-phase, wrong-root, wrong-reviewer, expired, replayed, wrong-order, or wrong-consumer rows/manifests fail closed. Definitions are not evidence receipts.

candidate_closure.capacity_rule: Overflow stops the life before a writer call under frozen missingness; never omit evidence, compress semantics, continue prior weights, or enlarge budget post hoc.

request_schema.digest: sha256 of all preceding canonical fields

candidate_closure.linearization: One durable transaction validates and equality-binds terminal candidate, complete trace, birth, initializer, cumulative evidence, writer/support/coverage-dose contracts, seed, terminal success, descriptor, and narrow lineage fact.
partial_and_crash_rules: candidate-only, trace-only, partial, failed, or crashed construction creates no descriptor, bridge, or staging authority
crash before linearization publishes nothing and quarantines derivatives
crash after linearization permits only identical-digest recovery
candidate_closure.descriptor: Non-dereferenceable life/sleep/candidate equality token plus closure root, namespace, expiry, and one-shot stage nonce only.
candidate_closure.lineage_receipt: Exposes declared closure facts and roots only, never candidate, trace, evidence, parent, repetition, DREAM, or timing content.
candidate_closure.stage_rule: Only seal success permits descriptor issuance; the stager obtains a later equality-only head token, so head mutation can affect eligibility but never candidate or trace bytes.

request_schema.digest: sha256 of all preceding canonical fields

transitions.effect: durably bind key to digest; no head/life mutation

transitions.event: all complete-head candidate verdict and replacement equalities pass
transitions.effect: single linearization atomically replaces head/life, appends receipt, persists response
persist fixed noncommit response; preserve head/life
resume only digest-bound request; no competing digest
fixed NOT_COMMITTED; no mutation or state leak
fixed NOT_COMMITTED; no record or mutation

promotion_cas.linearization_point: Atomic durable complete-head compare, active-head/life replacement, promotion receipt append, and COMMITTED response persistence.
fault_rules: concurrent requests: at most one COMMITTED
stale head, substitution, replay, expiry, crash-before, or conflict never mutates head/life
crash-after linearization recovers committed response exactly
promotion_cas.public_failure: All failures return same padded NOT_COMMITTED value/count/order/timing/cache/retry/error behavior; details quarantined.
promotion_cas.life_preservation: Every non-COMMITTED outcome preserves exact prior active head and continuing committed life.

finite_action_dag.expansion_rule: Before execution, seal every finite root/birth-arm/parent-arm/life/age/epoch/principal/invocation/call/retry/input/result instance. Wildcards, ranges, loops, callbacks, unbounded queues, umbrella dispatch, and hidden child calls are forbidden.
finite_action_dag.adaptive_rule: Adaptive policy selects only among pre-enumerated finite slots; unused slots produce deterministic SKIPPED receipts and no new node.
finite_action_dag.per_instance_gate: Before first token, call, write, allocation, transfer, or external effect, consume exact authority, matched opportunity, phase, contract, producer, predecessor, retry, expiry/replay, and result-identity roots.
finite_action_dag.retry_rule: Every attempt is enumerated with one logical invocation and unique retry identity; recovery follows only registered operation state machine.
finite_action_dag.split_rule: Executor, scorer, and reporter are separate nodes; executor lacks truth/scores, scorer lacks model execution, reporter lacks truth/transcript/model/development.
finite_action_dag.acyclicity: Every produced prerequisite rank is strictly lower than its consumer.
finite_action_dag.phase_row_production_rule: Each exact A_V8 phase producer deterministically materializes 21 unique row receipts and their equality-bound manifest; it hides no protected model/tokenizer/data/science call.

matched_opportunity.rule: Every invocation consumes its own exact receipt; umbrella, sibling, other-root/arm/life/age/epoch, or changed opportunity is denied.
matched_opportunity.fixed_parent: Exact bytes, scheduled age, order, timing, opportunity, model identity, decoding, and visible information are frozen across opposite histories; no child-history read.
matched_opportunity.parent_adapter: Neither parent has a personal learning adapter.

pre_gpu.rule: GPU consumes every applicable root plus M_V8_G2_CPU_DOMAIN; prose, generic pass, authority, or missing receipt never substitutes.

reporter.rule: Packet is consumed before reporter invocation and equality-bound with scores in report; no feedback, audit-authority, claim-authority, or release edge.

claim.rule: Claim action consumes powered evidence and cannot execute/produce endpoints, scores, analyses, audits, component receipts, or the evidence manifest.
claim.claim_row_producer_rule: Consumes and validates POWERED_CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST; cannot produce evidence or claim authority.

scientific_edges.labels: Receptivity bootstrap, teachability, and learning readiness are intervention nicknames only. Formal outputs use complete T-versus-D incremental immediate selective-advice-use or entry-normalized total-regime interactions unless powered prospective D/T/M0 competence, nondamage, ceiling, comparable-headroom, and equivalence/noninferiority gates permit narrower language.

generated_authorized_row_actions.rule: Harness enumerates the three exact A_V8 G0 actions; phase producers deterministically materialize canonical rows without protected nested invocation.

g0_echo_closure.child_authorization: One unique child authorization per concrete action, binding manifest root, every manifest root/value, action instance, scope, child nonce, expiry, and manifest nonce.
g0_echo_closure.installed_gate: A_V8_G0_INSTALL_FAIL_CLOSED_GATE consumes both phase manifests, exact harness, and echo-closed results; installed receipt echoes all roots.
g0_echo_closure.failure: Substituted, omitted, mixed, stale, permissive, wrong-action/scope/nonce, expired, replayed, or reordered values fail closed.
g0_echo_closure.emission: Exactly one result per concrete action in manifest order; identical retry returns identical bytes; denials have fixed padding/deadline.

release_chain.wrapper: Equality-binds concrete payload class/root to all nine tuple fields; bare-root and generic-wrapper authority forbidden.
release_chain.external_authority: Only X0_EXTERNAL_HUMAN_AUTHORITY_SOURCE authors exact unexpired one-shot release authority; code/models/auditors/reviewers/verifiers/controllers cannot author, widen, renew, or substitute it.
release_chain.verifier: Consumes only deterministic narrow attestations, external authority, tuple, and wrapper facts; never detailed findings, candidate, child, truth, score, report, parent, repetition, or DREAM.
release_chain.transfer: A_V8_G4_TRANSFER_OPAQUE_RELEASE performs exactly one opaque transfer after G4 manifest, verdict, tuple equality, wrapper, and tuple byte-equal.

visibility.observers: Every principal/source plus declared external human observer.
visibility.row_rule: Exactly one PRODUCER, CONSUMER, NARROW_OBSERVER, or FORBIDDEN cell per registered principal and channelized universe element.
visibility.dynamic_rule: Before a sealed invocation sub-DAG executes, regenerate WHOLE_SYSTEM_VISIBILITY_MANIFEST from exact registry/sub-DAG roots so every concrete action, receipt, result, retry, cache, error, and terminal output is included.
visibility.default: FORBIDDEN for direct, derived, copied, stale, cross-epoch, ambient, identifier, root, hash, count, order, timing, cache, retry, error, filename, and path access absent an exact edge.

attestation.roots: Copied from sealed manifest or deterministically derived; auditor cannot choose arbitrary roots.
attestation.count_order: Exactly one BLINDNESS then one LINEAGE attestation.
attestation.timing: Both PASS and FAIL visible only at issuer-fixed deadline; private buffering prevents timing leakage.
attestation.padding: Same registered width with all-zero nonwritable padding.
attestation.nonce_time: Issuer supplies nonce/deadline before input visibility; timestamps absent.
attestation.retry: Identical digest returns byte-identical cached bytes at same deadline; conflicting reuse gets generic fixed denial.
attestation.cache: Public request digest only; hit/miss/eviction invisible.
attestation.error: All internal failures map to FAIL/GENERIC_FAILURE with identical width/count/order/deadline.
attestation.quarantine: Detailed findings cannot affect verifier-visible bits, roots, count, order, timing, cache, retry, error, omission, or terminal output beyond PASS/FAIL and paired finite reason.

denial.details: Quarantined monitor only; unavailable to semantic, reporter, authority, claim, or release stages.

firewalls: Parent/repetition and DREAM value/count/order/timing/cache/retry/error/identifier/root/path/hash observables have no edge to evidence membership, SLEEP rendering/dose, candidates, or gradients.
Scores/reports have no edge to child, parent, DREAM, SLEEP, candidate, promotion, audit authority, or release.
Quarantined findings have no edge to reporter, authority, claim, or release.

matrix_contract.base_universe_generation: Deduplicated union resolved from canonical registry and finite action DAG.
matrix_contract.exact_cell_rule: Exactly one producer, consumer, observer, or forbidden cell per principal and element; no missing, duplicate, or extra cell.
